response.sql: WITH telescope_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM telescope_counts) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference FROM shares ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The telescopes table contains at least 10 distinct observatories; otherwise one row per observatory cannot yield exactly 10 rows.
